title.en: "24-ten" to Konyaku Hakisareta Reijou wa, Ringoku no Outaishi ni Kanpeki na Hanayome to Aisareru
Konyakusha ni Wasurerareta Watashi Ringoku no Koutaishi Denka to Gisou Konyaku suru Koto ni narimashita (※Tadashi, Denka no Honmei wa Watashi Mitai desu!?)
Konyaku Hakisareta "Kuuki" na Watashi, Nariagari no Danna-sama ni Totsugimashita
Kishi Reijou wa Propose wo Kotowarenai
Kojirase Outaishi to Yakusoku no Himegimi
Konyaku Haki Shita wo Baka na Ouji wa Hottoite, Akuyaku Reijou wa Seirei no Mori de Shiawase ni Narimasu.
Akuyaku Reijou Ni Tensei Shita Haha Wa Kosodate Kaikaku wo Itashimasu ～ Kekkon Wa Unzarinanode Outaishi Denka Wa Seijo Sama Ni Sashiagemasu ne ～
Akujo Reijou desu ga, Konyakusha no Amai Oshioki ni Kanaimasen

Shinigami Koushaku no Yatoware Tsuma ni narimashita ga, Kodomo-tachi ga Kawai sugite Mainichi Shiawase desu!
